topic: Technical requirements and UK dwell-time calculation
summary_markdown: The conversation covered technical development requirements, noting that the system must support HTML/CSS (flex, mobile/desktop compatibility) and Angular. A specific query was raised regarding the correct calculation of dwell-time on a live production environment for UK Mall data. It was noted that checking this requires viewing the 'stage' dataset rather than relying on visual estimation.
decisions: The system must support HTML/CSS (flex, mobile/desktop compatibility) and Angular.
action_items: Check the stage dataset for UK dwell-time calculation verification.
